versions.content: Ocu _ConfigType is a type of data structure containing the initialization data for the OCU driver. Mandatory parameters:  Symbolic name for channel / channel ID  maximum value of the counter  Time resolution in number of ticks  Notification function  Default value of the threshold  Minimu m v alue of the counter Optional parameters (if supported by hardware):  count direction  Ouput pin ( level s, and possible automatic actions).  Hardware triggered events (ADC or DMA) .  Microcontroller OCU - specific HW properties (optional prescaler , clock s ettings if supported by hardware) .
